scope: Curated faction guide and signature units; not the complete build roster or a balance database.

modes.name: Classic
modes.subtitle: World War III · classic engine
modes.description: Modern faction packs on OpenRA’s classic Red Alert battlefield. This is not the unmodified original roster.

modes.name: Red Alert 2
modes.subtitle: RA2 engine · modern factions
modes.description: The same faction identities, rebuilt for RA2’s isometric battlefield and rules. Requires owned Red Alert 2 game data.

factions.name: China
factions.title: Haitian Network
factions.story: A scattered force can hold ground. A connected force can choose where the battle happens. China’s fictional Haitian Network brings reconnaissance, precision armor and maritime reach into one coordinated offensive.
factions.playstyle: Keep specialists and escorts close to your main force. Use reconnaissance to commit your armor where it matters.
factions.strengths: Coordinated armor, specialist support and sea-to-land pressure.
factions.counterplay: Disrupt the supporting units and attack separated formations.

ra.description: Classic sprite-based battlefield with this modern faction’s native rules and roster.

ra2.description: RA2-specific actors and balance on an isometric battlefield. Shares the faction identity, not identical statistics or every mechanic.

factions.name: Iran
factions.title: Distributed Denial
factions.tagline: Make every approach a difficult choice.
factions.story: In this fictional theatre, a dispersed defense turns coastlines and narrow approaches into contested ground. Iran’s force combines reconnaissance, mobile armor and overlapping air defense to make the opponent fight on unfavorable terms.
factions.playstyle: Build overlapping coverage and keep scouting. Move your armor under protection instead of committing it alone.
factions.strengths: Layered denial and mobile combined arms.
factions.counterplay: Scout coverage gaps, split the defense and pressure isolated specialists.

ra.description: Classic sprite-based battlefield with this modern faction’s native rules and roster.

ra2.description: RA2-specific actors and balance on an isometric battlefield. Shares the faction identity, not identical statistics or every mechanic.

factions.name: Türkiye
factions.title: Anatolian Guard
factions.story: The Anatolian Guard is a fictional combined-arms force built to cross difficult ground without losing cohesion. Mechanized armor, drones and electronic warfare support a flexible approach to contested straits and inland routes.
factions.playstyle: Pair your armored spearhead with reconnaissance and air cover. Change the direction of pressure before the opponent settles.
factions.counterplay: Force unsupported units into fights and contest drone routes with air defense.

ra.description: Classic sprite-based battlefield with this modern faction’s native rules and roster.

ra2.description: RA2-specific actors and balance on an isometric battlefield. Shares the faction identity, not identical statistics or every mechanic.

factions.name: Saudi Arabia
factions.title: Red Sea Command
factions.tagline: Hold the corridor. Protect the lifeline.
factions.story: In the fictional Red Sea 2026 campaign, Saudi forces must keep vital routes open under pressure. Heavy armor and professional infantry anchor a force that can hold ground while air power supports the next advance.
factions.playstyle: Use armor to anchor the push and infantry to secure the ground it takes.
factions.strengths: Durable armored formations supported by infantry and air power.
factions.counterplay: Avoid frontal armor trades; scout and pressure exposed support routes.

ra.description: Classic sprite-based battlefield with this modern faction’s native rules and roster.

ra2.description: No RA2 implementation in the current modern-faction overlay. Explore this faction in Classic.

factions.name: Yemen
factions.title: Red Sea Resistance
factions.tagline: Choose the moment, not the front line.
factions.story: Across the fictional Red Sea 2026 theatre, a lighter force contests supply routes through mobility and selective pressure. Technicals and strike drones reward choosing engagements carefully instead of matching heavy armor head-on.
factions.playstyle: Scout first, attack exposed targets and relocate. Preserve mobile units for the next opportunity.
factions.strengths: Mobile harassment and asymmetric strike pressure.
factions.counterplay: Cover vulnerable routes and intercept light vehicles before they can disengage.

ra.description: Classic sprite-based battlefield with this modern faction’s native rules and roster.

ra2.description: No RA2 implementation in the current modern-faction overlay. Explore this faction in Classic.

units.name: Combined-Arms Rifleman
units.story: The infantry element that secures ground for a networked advance.
units.strengths: Use in numbers with supporting vehicles.
units.counterplay: Keep away from concentrated anti-infantry fire.

units.name: Qilin Main Battle Tank
units.story: A durable armored anchor with a precision cannon.
units.counterplay: Screen against infantry ambushes and air strikes.

units.name: Cloud Shadow UAV
units.story: A separate reconnaissance and precision-strike aircraft—not the carrier-launched drone.
units.strengths: Scout routes and strike exposed targets.
units.counterplay: Respect air defense and rearming windows.

units.name: Haiwang Drone Assault Ship
units.story: A high-value command ship that projects force through its drone wing.
units.counterplay: Protect the carrier from concentrated naval attacks.

units.name: Karrar Tank
units.story: The armored element of a dispersed combined-arms defense.
units.strengths: Operate within supporting reconnaissance and air-defense coverage.
units.counterplay: Avoid isolated advances into prepared anti-armor positions.

units.name: Raad Air Defense
units.story: A specialist escort that helps keep hostile aircraft away from the ground force.
units.counterplay: Cover against ground attackers; it is not a substitute for tanks.

units.name: Bozkir Tank
units.story: A main battle tank at the center of the Anatolian Guard’s mechanized force.
units.strengths: Advance with infantry and drone reconnaissance.
units.counterplay: Avoid unsupported pushes into specialist counters.

units.name: Kuzgun-M UCAV
units.story: An aerial strike platform supporting maneuver on the ground.
units.strengths: Find exposed targets before committing the flight.
units.counterplay: Plan around air defense and time away from the front to rearm.

units.name: M1A2S Tank
units.story: Heavy armor anchors Saudi formations in the Red Sea theatre.
units.strengths: Hold contested ground with infantry support.
units.counterplay: Protect against anti-tank ambushes and attacks on supporting units.

units.name: Saudi National Guard
units.story: The ground-holding infantry element of the Red Sea force.
units.counterplay: Avoid unsupported attacks into anti-infantry weapons.

units.name: Armed Technical
units.story: A light vehicle for opportunistic pressure, not heavy frontal combat.
units.strengths: Scout, strike exposed targets and relocate.
units.counterplay: Heavy armor and prepared defenses punish prolonged engagements.

units.name: Samad Drone
units.story: A strike drone whose attack culminates in a terminal dive.
units.strengths: Choose a valuable target and a viable approach.
units.counterplay: Air defenses can intercept it before impact.

assetPolicy.note: Existing project art and captured Classic assets. Labels are provenance, not independent redistribution clearance. RA2 screenshots are not substituted with Classic images.
